content: GitHub Copilot coding agent: assign issue to Copilot -> pushes commits to a DRAFT PR, trackable via session logs showing reasoning and validation steps. Runs behind restrictive network firewall allowing only package registries by default; orgs can allowlist domains. PRs require human approval before CI/CD workflows run. Config: AGENTS.md (supported since Aug 2025, nested files allowed), .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/instructions/**.instructions.md with YAML frontmatter path scoping, plus CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md. Build/test env declared via .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml (a GH Actions workflow run before the agent starts). Separate copilot-code-review.yml for review env. Docs explicitly advise teaching Copilot 'how to run any build steps, automated tests, or linters' for higher-quality PRs.
